units.source_text: 阿阇梨归山时，薰君嘱托他说：“我定当入山拜访，向八亲王请教佛法。

en.t: When the Ajari returned to the mountain, Lord Kaoru entrusted him with a message: “I will certainly come up to the mountain to visit and ask the Eighth Prince to teach me the Buddhist law.
At a convenient time, please go ahead of me, Master, and announce my visit.”

units.source_text: 冷泉院遣使入山，向八亲王传言：“传闻山居佳胜，深为喜慰。”

en.t: Retired Emperor Reizei sent a messenger into the mountains with this message for the Eighth Prince: “I hear your mountain dwelling is a fine and pleasant place, and this greatly comforts me.”
He also sent a poem, saying:
